content: पक्षः [पक्ष्-अच्] .²1 A wing, pinion; अद्यापि पक्षावपि नोद्भिद्येते <ls>K. 347</ls>; so उद्भिन्नपक्षः fledged; पक्षच्छेदोद्यतं शक्रम् <ls>R. 4. 40</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 42</ls>. .²2 The feather or feathers on each side of an arrow; अनुसंततिपातिनः पटुत्वं दधतः शुद्धिभृतो गृहीतपक्षाः (शराः) <ls>Śi. 20. 11</ls>. .²3 The flank or side of a man or animal, the shoulder; स्तम्बेरमा उभयपक्षविनीतनिद्राः <ls>R. 5. 72</ls>. .²4 The side of anything, a flank; वितत्य पक्षद्वयमायतम् <ls>Ki. 14. 31</ls>. .²5 The wing or flank of an army; सुपर्णपक्षानिलनुन्नपक्षम् (राक्षसराजसैन्यम्) <ls>Rām. 7. 6. 69</ls>. .²6 The half of anything. .²7 The half of a lunar month, a fortnight (comprising 15 days; there are two such {%pakṣas%}, शुक्लपक्षः the bright or light half, and कृष्ण-तमिस्र-पक्षः the dark half); तमिस्रपक्षेऽपि सह प्रियाभिर्ज्योत्स्नावतो निर्विशति प्रदोषान् <ls>R. 6. 34</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 66</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 50</ls>; सीमा वृद्धिं समायाति शुक्लपक्ष इवोडुराट् <ls>Pt. 1. 92</ls>; <ls>Mb. 3. 260. 5</ls>. .²8 .³({%a%}) A party in general, faction, side; प्रमुदितवरपक्षम् <ls>R. 6. 86</ls>; <ls>Śi. 2. 117</ls>; तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः <ls>Bg. 14. 25</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 53</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 17</ls>. .³({%b%}) A family, race; रूपान्वितां पक्षवतीं मनोज्ञां भार्यामयत्नोपगतां लभेत् सः <ls>Mb. 13. 57. 40</ls>; किं क्रन्दसि दुराक्रन्द स्वपक्षक्षयकारक <ls>Pt. 4. 29</ls>. .²9 One belonging to any party, a follower, partisan; विष्णुपक्षैः प्रतिच्छन्नैर्न भिद्येतास्य धीर्यथा <ls>Bhāg. 7. 5. 7</ls>; शत्रुपक्षो भवान् <ls>H. 1</ls>. .²10 A class, multitude, host, any number of adherents; as अरि˚, मित्र˚. .²11 One side of an argument, an alternative, one of two cases; पक्षे ‘in the other case, on the other hand’, पूर्व एवाभवत् पक्षस्तस्मिन्नाभवदुत्तरः <ls>R. 4. 10</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 34</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> पूर्वपक्ष and उत्तरपक्ष. .²12 A case or supposition in general; as in पक्षान्तरे. .²13 A point under discussion, a thesis, an argument to be maintained. .²14 The subject of a syllogism or conclusion (the minor term); संदिग्धसाध्यवान् पक्षः <ls>T. S.</ls>, दधतः शुद्धिभृतो गृहीतपक्षाः <ls>Śi. 20. 11</ls> (where it means ‘a feather’ also). .²15 A symbolical expression for the number ‘two’. .²16 A bird. .²17 A state, condition. .²18 The body. .²19 A limb of the body. .²20 A royal elephant. .²21 An army; <ls>Mb. 2. 16. 7</ls>. .²22 A wall. .²23 Opposition. .²24 Rejoinder, reply. .²25 A mass, quantity (when in composition with words meaning ‘hair’); केशपक्षः; <ab>cf.</ab> हस्त. .²26 Place, position. .²27 A view, notion, idea. .²28 The side of an equation in a primary division. .²29 The ash-pit of a fire-place. .²30 Proximity, neighbourhood. .²31 A bracket. .²32 Purity, perfection. .²33 A house. .²34 The sun (according to Sāyaṇa); सा पक्ष्या नव्यमायुर्दधाना <ls>Rv. 3. 53. 16</ls>.
